title: Premium Window for Building-Limit Increases on Loan Transactions, NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**Premium window — increase of the building limit recorded for a loan transaction, NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)**

The premium window for a pending increase of the building limit recorded for a loan transaction, on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, is measured from the request date to the payment date — the date of the latest premium payment on the policy received on or after the request date. Its length depends on how that payment came:

- **45 days** when the payment came from a lender's escrow account (an escrow disbursement);
- **30 days** when it came by any other method;
- **no days** when no payment was received.

When the premium was not received within the window, the change may take effect no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date.

| Payment on or after the request date | Days from request date to payment date | Within the window | Earliest effective date this window allows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Escrow disbursement | 45 or fewer | Yes | No limit from this window |
| Escrow disbursement | 46 or more | No | 30 days after the receipt date |
| Any other method | 30 or fewer | Yes | No limit from this window |
| Any other method | 31 or more | No | 30 days after the receipt date |
| None received | — | No | 30 days after the receipt date |

*Hypothetical case.* A check posted 30 days after the request date is within the window; a check posted 31 days after it is not, and the change can then be dated no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date.
